structure_backend.role: Production/Local HTTP & REST Server daemon with built-in security, authentication, and database routing
structure_backend.security_features: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 password hashing (100k rounds), rate-limiting per IP/endpoint, CORS domain whitelisting, 10MB payload cap, session tokens (8h TTL)

structure_backend.role: Portable zero-dependency SQLite abstraction layer with schema migrations, relational indexing, and automatic static JSON synchronization
structure_backend.data_layer: SQLite (sscs.db) with WAL mode & PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON
structure_backend.security_features: Strict prepared SQL statements, transactional integrity, automatic timestamping, before/after JSON change snapshots

structure_backend.role: Filesystem scanner that reads site/images/communities/<id>/ and synchronizes community-images.json and communities.json automatically
structure_backend.security_features: Sanitizes folder names, filters non-image files, supports .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp, .avif, .gif, .svg

structure_backend.role: Continuous filesystem watchdog that detects newly dropped photos and auto-triggers sync_images without manual CLI commands
structure_backend.security_features: Throttled debounce timer to prevent thrashing during multi-file file manager drops

structure_backend.role: Client-side progressive web app cache worker providing instant offline loading and stale-while-revalidate updates
structure_backend.security_features: Explicitly bypasses /api/*, /admin.html, and /js/admin.js from cache to guarantee zero security credential or data caching

dataflows.name: Client-Side Triple-Redundancy Cascade
dataflows.trigger_event: Page load on communities.html, community.html, or memorial.html
execution_order: 1. Check window.__INITIAL_COMMUNITIES__ from communities-data.js (Zero-delay render)
2. Simultaneously fire background fetch to /api/communities (if running on full Python backend)
3. If API responds (HTTP 200), update DOM with real-time database state and update cache
4. If API fails (e.g. static Git host like GitHub Pages), fallback to fetch("data/communities.json")
5. If static JSON fetch fails (e.g. offline file:// protocol), rely 100% on window.__INITIAL_COMMUNITIES__
dataflows.fallback_strategy: Guarantees the website renders flawlessly even if completely offline, on static hosting, or directly opened from a USB stick

dataflows.name: Admin Mutation & Auto-Sync Cycle
dataflows.trigger_event: Sister or Admin submits a change (station edit, new sister, event, or memorial record) via admin.html
execution_order: 1. Client sends JSON payload to POST /api/<entity> with Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
2. serve.py verifies token against in-memory active sessions and checks IP rate limit
3. serve.py calls db.py to take a JSON snapshot of the record BEFORE mutation
4. db.py writes mutation into SQLite tables within an ACID transaction
5. db.py records an entry in response_log with before/after snapshots and sister attribution
6. db.py triggers sync_all_to_json(), re-exporting communities.json, memorial.json, events.json, news.json, and communities-data.js
7. serve.py returns HTTP 200 JSON with updated entity ID and status
dataflows.fallback_strategy: Transaction rollback on error; static JSON files always match SQLite state 1-to-1

dataflows.name: One-Click Response Log Audit & Revert
dataflows.trigger_event: Admin reviews response logs and clicks "Revert" on an erroneous edit or upload
execution_order: 1. Admin selects log entry in admin.html Audit Trail tab and clicks "Revert"
2. POST /api/response-log/revert sent with log ID
3. db.py retrieves snapshot_before from response_log table
4. db.py restores the exact previous state into the target table
5. db.py updates response_log status to "reverted"
6. db.py re-triggers sync_all_to_json() to reflect the rollback in static files
7. Admin UI updates with success alert and reloads table
dataflows.fallback_strategy: Zero risk of data loss from sister mistakes; complete reversible history

dataflows.name: Photo Upload & Synchronization Pipeline
dataflows.trigger_event: User drops a photo in admin.html or directly into site/images/communities/<id>/
execution_order: 1. If via browser: POST /api/upload with multipart/form-data (community ID + file)
2. serve.py validates file extension (.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp, .avif) and size (<10MB)
3. File written to disk at site/images/communities/<id>/<filename>
4. serve.py calls sync_images.sync()
5. sync_images scans folder, assigns hero image (if named hero.* or first image), builds manifest
6. Writes site/data/community-images.json and injects hero/gallery paths into communities.json
7. If SQLite active, adds record to station_gallery table
dataflows.fallback_strategy: Auto-creates directories if missing; natural sorting on image numbers (img1, img2, img10)

dataflows.name: Public Contact, Prayer, & Newsletter Submission
dataflows.trigger_event: Visitor submits contact message, prayer intention, or newsletter email
execution_order: 1. Browser fires fetch() to /api/contact, /api/prayers, or /api/newsletter
2. serve.py checks IP rate limiter (prevent spam floods: max 5-10 per minute)
3. Sanitizes strings and escapes HTML tags to neutralize XSS
4. Stores record in contact_messages, prayer_requests, or newsletter_subscribers table
5. If prayer request: initially marked "pending" until reviewed in admin portal
6. Returns HTTP 200 {"success": true}
dataflows.fallback_strategy: Client-side optimistic UI with friendly thank you confirmation and graceful network error alerts

agent_quick_memorise.one_liner: Spiritual, Archival & Dignified Aesthetic with Editorial Brutalism
golden_rules: Primary Brand is Deep Ocean Blue (#0d4b6b), Accent is Warm Amber (#e8833a)
Headings MUST use Young Serif; UI and Body MUST use Hanken Grotesk
Dark Mode is controlled via data-theme="dark" attribute with inline IIFE in <head> to prevent flash of unstyled content
Never add external npm packages or bulky web UI frameworks; preserve vanilla HTML5/CSS/JS purity
Photos must always feature fallback symbolic badges (Mission, Families, Service) if no image exists
agent_quick_memorise.common_mistakes_to_avoid: Do not use generic blue/red/green or bootstrap-style alert boxes. Stick to custom CSS tokens.

agent_quick_memorise.one_liner: Static First JAMstack with Optional Cloud Run Server Container
golden_rules: site/ is the complete deployable deliverable for static web hosting (GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Netlify)
scripts/ contains all Python backend, sync engines, and database tooling
Database sscs.db lives in scripts/data/sscs.db OUTSIDE the publicly-served site/ folder for security
GitHub Actions workflow in .github/workflows/deploy.yml strips .db and backups before publishing
PWA service worker site/sw.js explicitly excludes admin.html and admin.js from caching
agent_quick_memorise.common_mistakes_to_avoid: Never save sensitive databases, password hashes, or backup directories inside site/.

agent_quick_memorise.one_liner: Triple-Redundant Cascade: Global JS -> Fetch JSON -> REST API
golden_rules: Always check window.__INITIAL_*__ first so pages render with zero latency offline
Whenever mutating data in admin.html or db.py, always call sync_all_to_json() to keep static files matching SQLite
Every mutation records a snapshot_before in response_log for instant one-click revertability
Images dropped into site/images/communities/<id>/ are auto-mapped by sync_images.py natural sort
agent_quick_memorise.common_mistakes_to_avoid: Never edit communities.json directly without syncing communities-data.js and sscs.db.

agent_quick_memorise.one_liner: Zero-Cost Free Tier GitOps with 60-Second Auto Deployments
golden_rules: GitHub Pages runs zero Python: purely static CDN delivering JSON and assets
Google Cloud Run container reads $PORT (8080), binds to 0.0.0.0, and scales to zero when idle ($0 cost)
Cloudflare Pages supports security headers directly via site/_headers
Cloud Storage FUSE can be mounted to /app/scripts/data and /app/site/images/communities for persistent Cloud Run storage
agent_quick_memorise.common_mistakes_to_avoid: Do not require a Python backend for public browsing; public site is 100% static-capable.

agent_quick_memorise.one_liner: Defense in Depth: Strict CSP, PBKDF2 Password Hashing & Rate Limits
golden_rules: Strict Content-Security-Policy restricts scripts to self and approved CDNs (Leaflet, unpkg)
PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 password hashing with 100,000 iterations for admin protection
Rate limits applied per client IP on login, uploads, forgot-password, and public submissions
Input escaping in frontend (esc() function) and parameter-binding in backend to defeat XSS and SQL injection
agent_quick_memorise.common_mistakes_to_avoid: Never send the admin password hash to the client. Keep sessions in-memory with 8-hour TTL.
